events.title: LLM Tycoon - 0.8.0.0 Update
events.summary: Hi everyone,Here’s what’s new in the latest LLM Tycoon update.Chirp & Notifications Notifications were arriving too often, so we changed how frequently they come in. We also added a “Mute” button to the Chirp panel. When it’s on, notifications keep arriving quietly in the background without getting in the way of your game. events.title: LLM Tycoon Demo is released!
events.summary: Hello,The moment we've all been waiting for is finally here: our demo is now playable. First of all, thank you from the whole team for your interest in LLM Tycoon and for giving the demo a try.With this update, we'd like to share the changes we've made in the game's current version, 0.7.5.1.All of the systems we designed for the 1.0 release are now in the game. events.title: Development Update - 0.7.0
events.summary: Hello, With version 0.7.0, we've added a range of new systems and features to LLM Tycoon. Below we've laid out the highlights for you. New SystemsDistillation System We've added a new mechanic to the game's core loop of building and releasing AI models. You can now "distill" your large models into smaller, cheaper, and faster versions. You can also distill your rivals' models — but be careful, this comes with the risk of a lawsuit. events.title: Development Update — v0.3.0: The State of LLM Tycoon
events.summary: Development Update — v0.3.0: The State of LLM TycoonHey everyone! This is our first development update on Steam. LLM Tycoon is in active development, and version 0.3.0 is our biggest milestone yet — so it's a good moment to show you where the game stands today.
